title: How early jazz was played and views on rock and roll
summary: Murray says jazz was improvised from a hummed tune on plain chords with no written arrangements or fancy extensions, and comments on changing styles like rock and roll.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
